label: 収支
subject: Japanese black lacquer accounting ledger, soroban abacus and gold koban coins
prompt: Create one dedicated UI icon for the finances / income and expenses tab of a Japanese Sengoku strategy game. A small traditional Japanese wooden accounting ledger with a short soroban abacus laid diagonally across its bottom corner and a modest group of gold koban coins, visually conveying income and expenditure bookkeeping. Rich black lacquer wood, warm gold accents, ivory ledger pages, subtle Japanese engraving. Polished detailed painterly game inventory icon, readable silhouette at very small 24px artwork size. One coherent compact composition centered on a square transparent canvas with 10% clear margin, true transparent background. No text, no writing, no numbers, no letters, no crest, no background scenery, no circular badge, no decorative outer frame. Match a Japanese black-lacquer and gold ornamental HUD; distinct from a simple currency coin icon.
